Startup checks local Tailscale, DNS and tunnel state. Verify the remote connections you need. Saving remains available; confirm or revert before applying other settings.
Lists FoxyTail configuration backups in Download. Preview changes before restoring. Account identity is never displayed or restored.

Slow watchdog, traffic and context checks; pause automatic network probes while keeping the main connection. Independently disabled features stay off.
Let the watchdog test network reachability. Turning this off keeps process checks but stops background probe packets.
Power saving is active: background probes are paused. This switch retains its saved preference.
Collect and retain traffic history. Turning this off stops sampling and the statistics process.
Run context rules when networks change. Turning this off keeps the rules but stops automatic checks and actions.
Periodically update status, devices, tunnel and logs. Manual refresh and active trial countdowns and status checks remain available when disabled.
Auto-refresh is disabled in Settings. Manual refresh remains available.
Restart the service to apply network and background settings. Your connection will briefly pause.
Changes save automatically. Apply pending settings together with a service restart.

Enter an integer within the allowed range.

Generate a mihomo / Clash.Meta merge fragment from the applied configuration. Read-only: no proxy configuration or device networking changes.
Not detected yet. Reads and probes are on demand; no automatic DNS or connectivity checks.
Installed modules and apps are informational, not proof of a running proxy, core type or fake-IP mode.
No known proxy modules or apps found. Other proxies may still exist.

A ready local or transparent MagicDNS listener for the current Tailnet with FoxyTail-owned policy is required. Configure and apply it in Settings, then detect again. Legacy DNS is not supported by this wizard.
For mihomo / Clash.Meta cores supporting these fields only. Inspect the destination configuration and choose explicitly; the wizard never infers or switches its mode.
Mode currently used by the destination

Whitelist exclusions have different semantics. A safe fragment requires reviewing the existing list. Manually review and adjust the destination policy first, then select its actual mode. No automatic conversion to blacklist.
The current suffix, listener state, ports or node addresses are invalid. A safe fragment cannot be generated. Detect again.

Not a complete configuration! Merge into the existing dns and nameserver-policy maps and proxies / rules / fake-ip-filter lists, preserving other entries. Prepend routing rules and rule-mode filter rules before catchalls. Do not replace the whole configuration or use this local listener as a global DNS upstream.
Only the current full Tailnet suffix and exact self/peer /32 and /128 addresses. No short names, company DNS, subnet or exit routes are imported. Regenerate for new IP-literal targets.
FoxyTail-Tailnet must be unique in the destination. If renamed, update all rule references too. Copying does not mean the destination configuration is applied.
tun uses a direct outbound bound to tailscale0. The destination core needs interface-name support and interface permission. Another VPN app may not be able to use this binding.
bridge / proxy uses the actual applied local SOCKS5 port. The destination proxy must be able to reach that listener.
Global IPv6 settings are unchanged. For AAAA, separately confirm that FoxyTail IPv6 and the destination mihomo AAAA support are enabled.

Runs only on request. DNS uses root loopback access. TCP connects to the selected numeric address and port without sending application data. Generating a fragment is not required, and results do not prove it was applied.
No current peer is available to verify. You can still generate a fragment containing self addresses.
Supply an actual service port (1–65535); ports are not discovered. Optional DNS is fixed to 127.0.0.1 and must differ from the FoxyTail DNS port. Leave blank to explicitly skip.
Ports must be 1–65535. The optional proxy DNS port must differ from the FoxyTail DNS port.
Checking DNS and target TCP independently…
The current state changed or the result identity did not match. Detect again.
root / system routing → current peer (proxy interface binding not verified)
TCP connection to the specified port

Only the listed root probes at this moment are established. DNS, proxy DNS and TCP are independent, not substitutes for one another. They do not prove a third-party app path, proxy rules or configuration are active, nor verify UDP traffic, ACLs or application health.

Unrecognized line. The original text is preserved; correct it in the advanced editor.
Invalid rule: SSID cannot contain colons, #, quotes or control characters. An exit node needs a name or IP.

Only Taildrop-capable receiving devices are listed. Choose files and a target, then Send. Transfers continue in the background; return here for progress.
Invalid Taildrop response. Refresh and try again.
Job submission is not delivery. A file is completed only after the receiving device accepts it.
Waiting for daemon progress; sent bytes are unknown.
Progress is temporarily unavailable; the job may still be running. This is not a failed send result.
Cancellation requested; waiting for the background job to acknowledge.
Retry failed or cancelled files only
The original target cannot receive right now. Refresh receiving devices before retrying.
Import completed files from /sdcard/Download/Taildrop; originals are retained. If direct receive mode is unknown, unlock shared storage and restart FoxyTail.
